subject.title: [优化建议] install.sh 模块化拆分以提升可维护性

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a modular `scripts/install.sh` architecture now, and must the public `openclaw.ai/install.sh` artifact remain a generated or preserved single-file entrypoint?
rationale: The request is maintainability cleanup rather than broken behavior, and current docs, release artifacts, tests, and website sync all assume one served installer script on a stable setup surface.

options.title: Sponsor a guarded split
options.body: Approve an incremental split only if it preserves or generates one safe public entrypoint and keeps website sync plus installer smoke proof aligned.

options.title: Allow focused extractions only
options.body: Keep this as backlog guidance and extract small helpers only when tied to concrete installer bugs, validation improvements, or owner-approved cleanup.

options.title: Keep the installer monolithic
options.body: Decide that the served shell installer should stay single-file to minimize helper-loading, packaging, and compatibility risk.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a guarded split
recommendation.body: Approve an incremental split only if it preserves or generates one safe public entrypoint and keeps website sync plus installer smoke proof aligned.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent installer and release-path history makes this the strongest available owner for deciding whether a split belongs in the setup roadmap.
